summary: CoreOT APM: comprehensive backend + frontend testing completed. All 26 backend pytest cases pass (auth, dashboard, assets CRUD, filtering, hierarchy, alarms, areas/plants, telemetry ingest with WARNING/CRITICAL/STOPPED transitions, alarm creation from ingest, telemetry latest/history, WebSocket auth rejection without token, WebSocket broadcast on ingest). Frontend flows verified end-to-end: /login renders correctly with tenant dropdown, email/password, remember me, sign-in button and 5 demo account buttons; login redirects to /dashboard which shows all 6 KPI cards + Assets by Area, Asset Health Overview, Alarms Trend, Recent Alarms, Top Faulty Assets; /assets shows 45 (46 after test-created asset) rows with pagination, Area/Type/Status filters (RUNNING filter validated), Add Asset button; Asset 360 for CNC-DEMO-01 shows health gauge, digital twin area, production stats, all 8 telemetry cards (Temperature, Vibration, Pressure, RPM, Voltage, Current, Power, Energy), Live Telemetry Trend chart, and 'Live' WebSocket indicator; Add Asset dialog creates new asset that appears in the list; Logout returns to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: Add Asset dialog does not validate that plant_id is selected; only checks asset_code and area_id. On first load plant_id is auto-populated from first plant, but if plants endpoint fails, submission would send empty plant_id and backend would silently accept it (no FK check).

GET /api/telemetry/ingest is unauthenticated by design for Node-RED - server.py comment mentions INGEST_KEY header check when configured but no such check is actually implemented. Production hardening required.

Sidebar items (Users, Roles, Module Access, Field Access, Alarms, Reports, Work Orders, Settings) are all disabled (pointer-events-none). Consider hiding OR marking as coming-soon since a Tenant Admin dashboard app is expected to expose these.
assets_by_area chart in dashboard renders area labels but no visible bars in the screenshot - may indicate CSS/render issue with the bar chart component (verify data-testid on bars).
WebSocket connect success case in test_ws_requires_token relies on error surface; production could send an initial hello message so clients can distinguish auth failure vs no data.
seed_database inserts users/assets/alarms sequentially with per-doc awaits - fine for one-time seed but consider insert_many for cleaner code.
Route ordering OK: /assets/hierarchy is defined before /assets/{asset_id} so it does not get shadowed.
test_credentials: Tenant SBF / tenantadmin@sbforgtech.com / Admin@123 (and other roles listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds SBF tenant, 5 users, 1 plant (Pune), 4 areas, 45 assets and 12 alarms on startup. Tests created 2 extra TEST-* assets (one via API test, one via UI test); no DELETE endpoint exists so total asset count in dashboard now shows 47.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints including WebSocket. Note that total_assets in /api/dashboard/summary drifts above 45 because backend has no DELETE /api/assets endpoint and tests create assets. This is expected. WebSocket URL uses wss:// (from https://) with ?token=<jwt>. Telemetry simulator ticks every 5s so /assets/CNC-DEMO-01/telemetry/latest is always populated a few seconds after startup.
